name: harden-gm-two-player-campaign-sessions
reason: User-approved declarative-first change for one non-playing GM plus two tactical players: durable command journaling and publication, role-safe live/replay/export projection, reconnect cursors, outcome receipts, append-only correction and rewind, campaign retroactive rebuild, and a strict 80-scenario three-context acceptance program. Implementation is intentionally split into small independently verified PRs with exact-main post-merge regression audits. Its e2e-testing delta adds distinct GM/two-player requirements and does not modify the active add-subsystem-lanes-and-ci requirement names.
